text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's finally time for my first battle<n>against Taiki! She
says she would've<n>preferred to race me when I'm
feeling better, but I feel the opposite!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
All of these hindrances I've had to<n>face have led
me to new possibilities!<n>I'm going to test if I can
take on the<n>world with this new running of mine!
